title: Dreamed of a mall that resembles a house with parking lot in front a backyard
content: Thank goodness for AI to recreate this. It did have white windows. It has only one floor but the lot was huge. I remember on the way with factional street names. It's 3 blocks away and mostly surrounded by farms. First store I went to was Gamestop but they sell mostly cassette tapes. Then there was a gym on the backyard side where people in multiple tables playing chess inside
